blurb.en-US: Every battle scene filmed in the game engine, by battlefield: each scene with its close-up and other moments, then the motion-blur studies.
blurb.zh-CN: 在游戏引擎中拍摄的全部战斗场景，按战场分组：每个场景附特写与其他瞬间，最后是运动模糊研究。

blurb.en-US: Every vehicle on its battlefield, with a close-up and other moments, by country.
blurb.zh-CN: 每辆载具在其战场上的画面，附特写与其他瞬间，按国家分组。

blurb.en-US: Two tanks, one frame: the duels, by time of day.
blurb.zh-CN: 两辆坦克，同框对决：按时段分组的对决。

blurb.en-US: Firefights filmed in the game engine: one on one, and one against two.
blurb.zh-CN: 在游戏引擎中拍摄的交火：一对一，以及以一敌二。

blurb.en-US: The pictures of the home page's features, mechanics and game modes.
blurb.zh-CN: 首页功能、机制与游戏模式的图片。

blurb.en-US: Key art from the media kit, by time of day, and the posters.
blurb.zh-CN: 媒体包中的主视觉，按时段分组，以及海报。

blurb.en-US: Every battlefield seen from above, and its map card.
blurb.zh-CN: 每个战场的俯瞰图，以及它的地图卡。

blurb.en-US: The game's screens: in battle, the Tank Gallery and the Scene Studio.
blurb.zh-CN: 游戏的各个界面：战斗中、坦克画廊与场景工作室。
